The '''''Plain Lady''''' was a [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] in use in [[44 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Valin Horn]] and [[Jysella Horn]] went undercover aboard the [[EconoClass]] starliner to the [[Galactic Center Spaceport]] to infiltrate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] the world from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].
